THE ENGINE'S 2026-09-02 BAKE ALSO PRODUCED A STOP, AND IT DISAGREES -- the instruction's claim that the bake 'priced nothing' is false, and so was the first version of this note, which repeated it. THE ENGINE'S VALUE IS THE WRONG ONE, and the cause is demonstrated rather than guessed: dropping the single 2026-08-28 bar from today's frame reproduces the engine's published sma20 AND its atr14 SIMULTANEOUSLY, for HPQ, OXY and CNC at once. For HPQ the ATR is what disambiguates -- two candidate bars (08-26 and 08-28) both reproduce the sma20 because both closed at 30.52, but only 08-28 also reproduces the atr14. That is the same missing-bar defect the open SMA20 chip documents and the same bar that had vanished from FTNT's frame on 2026-09-01; it has since healed, which is why the frame can produce the basis-correct value today and the engine could not on the night. The frame value is therefore recorded and the engine's is recorded here beside it, neither silently preferred. entry_stop $29.92 = SMA20 on the 2026-09-02 confirmed close (29.9185 unrounded). The figures supplied with the instruction (~$443 risk, ext ~1.69x, ~7.22% per share) were computed off the ~30.00 stop; on the frame they become $458.66, 1.701x and 7.47%. ATR14 1.4200 = 4.39% of price (supplied ~4.3%). || THE WIDTH, WHICH IS THE POINT OF THIS ROW: 7.47% per share is the WIDEST OF THE FIFTEEN POSITIONS NOW HELD, ahead of SMCI's 7.24%. IT IS NOT THE WIDEST THE BOOK HAS EVER TAKEN, and the instruction's phrasing would have made it so: across all 35 entries on record it ranks 32nd, with NET 7.71%, DELL 7.98% and VSAT 9.31% wider, all three closed. On the supplied ~30.00 stop it would be 7.22% and 31st. The correction is recorded because a superlative in a permanent record has to be true; the entry decision itself is the operator's and is not re-argued here. || EXTENSION: 1.701xATR, INSIDE the 1.8x guard — the line sits at 29.9185 + 1.8 x 1.4200 = $32.4745, which is $0.14 ABOVE the fill.
